infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need access to your camera to allow you to record videos for translation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We need access to your microphone to capture audio for your videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photo library so you can select videos to translate.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: We need access to save the translated videos to your photo library.
